questions.q: About what percent of Earth's surface is covered by water?
questions.why: About 71% is water and 29% is land.

questions.q: Which is the largest continent?
questions.why: Asia is the largest continent, and India is in it.

questions.q: Which is the largest ocean?
questions.why: The Pacific is the largest and the deepest ocean.

questions.q: Which is the smallest continent?
questions.why: Australia is the smallest continent.

questions.q: Which ocean is named after a country?
questions.why: The Indian Ocean is named after India.

questions.q: The Deccan Plateau is in which part of India?
questions.why: The Deccan Plateau covers much of south India.

questions.q: Which landform is best for farming and building cities?
questions.why: Plains are flat with fertile soil and water, so farming, roads and buildings are easy.

questions.q: What kind of mountains are the Himalayas?
questions.why: The Himalayas were formed when land was pushed and folded, so they are fold mountains.

questions.q: Why are plateaus important for industry?
options: They are close to the sea
questions.why: Plateaus are rich in minerals like coal and iron, which factories need.

questions.q: In which state is the Thar Desert?
questions.why: The Thar Desert is mainly in Rajasthan.

questions.q: What does BCE stand for?
questions.why: BCE means Before the Common Era. It counts backwards.

questions.q: Which is earlier?
questions.why: BCE numbers count backwards, so 300 BCE is longer ago than 100 BCE.

questions.q: About how many years are there from 500 BCE to 100 CE?
questions.why: The dates are on different sides of year 1, so add them: 500 + 100 = 600.

questions.q: Ashoka's edicts carved on rocks and pillars are examples of ___.
questions.why: Writing carved on stone or metal is an inscription.

questions.q: Who digs up and studies objects from the past?
questions.why: Archaeologists dig up and study old objects.

questions.q: What are the three tiers of Panchayati Raj, from village to district?
options: Zila Parishad, Panchayat Samiti, Gram Panchayat
Gram Panchayat, Panchayat Samiti, Zila Parishad
Panchayat Samiti, Gram Panchayat, Zila Parishad
Gram Sabha, Zila Parishad, Panchayat Samiti
questions.why: Village: Gram Panchayat. Block: Panchayat Samiti. District: Zila Parishad.

questions.q: Who is the head of a Gram Panchayat?
questions.why: The elected head of a Gram Panchayat is the Sarpanch.

questions.q: Who are the members of the Gram Sabha?
options: Only the Sarpanch and ward members
All the adult voters of the village
questions.why: The Gram Sabha is a meeting of all the adult voters of the village.

questions.q: For how many years are Gram Panchayat members elected?
questions.why: The term is 5 years.

questions.q: What share of seats in a panchayat is reserved for women?
questions.why: At least one-third of seats are reserved for women. Some states set aside even more.

questions.q: Farming is which kind of economic activity?
questions.why: Farming takes things directly from nature, so it is primary.

questions.q: A teacher's work is which kind of economic activity?
questions.why: A teacher provides a service, so teaching is tertiary.

questions.q: Making cloth in a factory is which kind of activity?
questions.why: Making goods from raw materials is secondary.

questions.q: Which of these is a service?
questions.why: A haircut is work done for you. The others are things you can touch, which are goods.

questions.q: What is barter?
questions.why: Barter means exchanging goods directly, such as wheat for cloth.
